extension.summary: A dark, Trakt-inspired skin built around Elementum.
extension.description: Trakt Style rebuilds Kodi's Estuary skin to look and feel like the Trakt web app: deep ink background, purple accent, Roboto type, rounded poster and episode cards, a Media / Shows / Movies switcher on the home screen and Trakt-like movie and show pages. Home rows come straight from Elementum's Trakt lists (Continue Watching, Calendar, Watchlist, Trending, Anticipated and more). Personal rows appear automatically once Elementum is signed in to Trakt. Not affiliated with or endorsed by Trakt.
extension.disclaimer: Unofficial fan skin. Trakt is a trademark of trakt, inc.

extension.summary: Installs and updates the Trakt Style skin.
extension.description: Kodi add-on repository for the Trakt Style skin (a Trakt-inspired Estuary mod built around Elementum). Install the skin from Install from repository - Trakt Style Repository - Look and feel - Skin; new versions arrive through Kodi's normal add-on updates.
